text: Evening. I'm probably overthinking this, but my wife said to message so here goes. Our son is 8 and about an hour ago he was messing about with his brother and banged his head on the edge of the dining table. Quite a thud. He cried straight away, proper loud crying, which I think is meant to be a good sign? He settled after maybe five minutes with a cold flannel on it. Since then he's been totally himself as far as I can tell. He's eaten a yoghurt, argued with me about bedtime, and is now lying on the sofa telling me facts about sharks. The only other thing is I took his temperature while I was at it, just because the thermometer was out, and it's 37.9. I don't know if that's anything to do with the bump or just him being a bit warm from running around, he's been fine all day otherwise. There's a small red mark on his forehead, not much swelling that I can see. I suppose I just want to know whether there's anything I should be keeping an eye on tonight, or whether I'm fine to let him go to bed as normal. Thanks.
